text:
ana: Quick report: streaming issues on hosted API after client reconnects. Some clients see chunk ordering flipped and missing final done event.
kevin: Can you share raw stream capture + SDK and client lib/version?
ana: Using inference-js v0.9.2 and a mobile client. Raw (simplified):
```
data: {"seq":1,"text":"Hi "}
data: {"seq":2,"text":"there"}

<disconnect>
/data: {"seq":2,"text":"there"}
data: {"seq":3,"text":"!"}
/event: done
```
Note stray leading `/` and duplicate seq=2 after reconnect.
priya: This looks like chunk-split + proxy coalescing. Python SDK reported similar but parsed differently (parity issue).
kevin: For JS we patched parser to buffer partial lines and consider `\n\n` as event boundary only when not inside JSON; also added seq-based dedupe. PR planned.
ana: Mobile libs also close idle sockets fast. We get timeouts around 60s. Increasing client read timeout and adding server pings helps.
ci-bot: test-run(streaming-reconnect): 4/5 tests passed, 1 flaky fail (packet-split). See logs: https://ci.internal/streams/556
priya: Action items: 1) server must emit `id:` header per SSE event (monotonic), 2) emit `:ping` every 25s, 3) SDKs adopt state-machine parser and reorder by id with short hold (200ms) to wait for missing seq.
kevin: Also add session header X-Stream-Session and honor Last-Event-ID on reconnect so server can resume; avoids duplicate replay on auth retry.
ana: I made a tiny repro in examples/sse-repro that simulates mid-stream TCP close. Works locally.
qa-bot: Add integration: mid-stream close + reconnect ensures final assembled text equals golden. Marked flaky until parser changes.
priya: For SDK parity, make sure Python/Go accept leading stray chars (strip non-alphanum before token) and preserve generator/iterator semantics.
kevin: I'll open SDK issues: SDK-600 parser, SDK-601 session header, SDK-602 reorder. Link PRs when ready.
ana: Also document onboarding note: if you use an older HTTP client on mobile, bump socket read timeout and enable keepalive or the stream may be cut.
priya: Deploy plan: server patch INF-1100 behind a feature flag, SDK changes in minor release, then enable default reorder in next major with `sse_legacy_mode=true` for one release.
kevin: Logging: record last-event-id and session id on reconnects to detect gaps. Send a metric when server reports a missing id range.
ana: Thanks — will test JS patch + staging server pings and update thread.
kevin: Thanks :+1:
